venues.name: Knoch Park
venues.note: Big park with a zipline, disc golf course, and a popular sledding hill in winter.

venues.name: Wolf's Crossing Community Park
venues.note: Splash pad, ninja course, and a mini playground built for the littlest kids.

venues.name: Naperville Jaycee Playground
venues.note: Shaded and small — an easy add-on to a downtown Riverwalk visit.

venues.name: Winding Creek Park
venues.note: Playground plus a fishing pond. No restrooms on site — plan ahead.

venues.name: Gartner Park
venues.note: Sand play area with separate sections for under-3s and up to age 12.

venues.name: 95th Street Community Plaza & Splash Pad
venues.note: Fenced splash pad right next to the 95th St. Library — easy combo trip.

venues.name: Prairie Point Splash Park
venues.note: A bit further out, but fenced with restrooms and a playground next door.

venues.name: DuPage Children's Museum
venues.hours: Check website — hours vary by day
venues.note: Large, hands-on museum downtown. A go-to for rainy days; has a cafe on site.

venues.name: Urban Air Trampoline and Adventure Park
venues.hours: Mon–Thu 4–8 PM, Fri 4–9 PM, Sat 10 AM–9 PM, Sun 12–8 PM
venues.note: Indoor trampolines, ninja course, arcade. Reviews mention some attractions are inconsistently open — worth calling ahead.
venues.cost: ~$25/person all-day pass (~$12.50 for 40" & under); $4 socks required

venues.name: Naperville Public Library – Nichols Library
venues.hours: Mon–Fri 9 AM–9 PM, Sat 9 AM–5 PM, Sun 1–9 PM
venues.note: Downtown location; the whole bottom floor is dedicated kids' space.

venues.name: Naperville Public Library – 95th Street Library
venues.hours: Mon–Fri 9 AM–9 PM, Sat 9 AM–5 PM, Sun 1–9 PM
venues.note: Attached to a playground and splash pad — read, then run it off outside.

venues.name: Naperville Public Library – Naper Blvd. Library
venues.hours: Mon–Fri 9 AM–9 PM, Sat 9 AM–5 PM, Sun 1–5 PM
venues.note: Quieter kids' area and easier parking than the downtown branch.

venues.name: Blackberry Farm
venues.hours: Fri 9:30 AM–3:30 PM, Sat 9:30 AM–5 PM, Sun 11 AM–5 PM (seasonal, closed Mon–Thu)
venues.note: Historic farm: ponies, train, carousel, petting zoo. Great for toddlers.

venues.name: Knoch Knolls Nature Center
venues.hours: Mon–Fri 9 AM–4:30 PM, Sat 9 AM–3 PM, Sun closed
venues.note: Paved trails, an aquarium inside, and a disc golf course.

venues.name: Cosley Zoo
venues.note: Small, affordable zoo (~$8 admission), well suited to toddlers.
venues.cost: Free for kids 11 & under and Wheaton residents; $12 non-resident adults ($10 seniors)

venues.name: Lucky Strike Naperville
venues.hours: 4 PM–12 AM weekdays, later Fri/Sat, 11 AM Sat/Sun
venues.note: Bowling plus arcade; bumper lanes available for little bowlers.
venues.cost: Paid — pay-per-game bowling + arcade, varies by time
venues.age: All ages (bumpers/ramps for little bowlers; some evenings go 21+)

venues.name: Main Event Warrenville
venues.note: Bowling, ropes course, arcade, laser tag — good for birthday parties.
venues.age: 6+ for laser tag & ropes course (height minimums apply); bowling/arcade fine for all ages

venues.name: Round1 Bowling & Arcade – Aurora
venues.address: 2480 Fox Valley Center Dr B13, Aurora, IL 60504
venues.note: Bowling, arcade, karaoke — gutter guards available for kids.
venues.cost: Paid — pay-per-game bowling + arcade credits, varies by time
venues.age: 8+ — reviewers say it skews toward older kids/teens; loud, two-floor arcade

venues.name: McDowell Grove Forest Preserve
venues.note: Trails along the DuPage River; some sections are stroller-friendly.
venues.age: All ages — flat trail, paved/stroller-friendly sections

venues.name: Danada Forest Preserve
venues.note: Wide gravel trails and an equestrian center; deer sightings are common.
venues.age: All ages for trails & barn visits; formal riding lessons require 12+

venues.name: Springbrook Prairie
venues.note: A 6-mile crushed-limestone loop — good for a jogging stroller.
venues.age: All ages, best for biking or strollers — full loop is 5–6 miles with little shade

venues.name: Riverview Farmstead Preserve
venues.note: Small and quiet, with a paved trail and a kayak launch.
venues.age: All ages — short paved trail, easy with a stroller
